# InventiveClicks

> InventiveClicks is a creative digital marketing agency that helps brands turn
> attention into growth through video animation, graphic design, creative
> marketing campaigns and influencer marketing. Tagline: "Ideas that click."

## About
InventiveClicks is a full-service creative digital marketing agency founded in 2019.
One team covers strategy, motion, design, influence and web — so campaigns move
fast and stay consistent. Creative work always ships with a measurable target
attached. Serves brands worldwide.

Website: https://inventiveclicks.com
Contact: hello@inventiveclicks.com

## Services
- Video Animation — 2D & 3D motion graphics, explainer videos, product animation, social reels and VFX. https://inventiveclicks.com/services/video-animation
- Graphic Design — brand identity, social creative, packaging, print and brand systems. https://inventiveclicks.com/services/graphic-design
- Creative Marketing — full-funnel campaign strategy, performance creative, landing pages and A/B testing. https://inventiveclicks.com/services/creative-marketing
- Influencer Marketing — vetted creator partnerships, UGC, whitelisting and end-to-end campaign management. https://inventiveclicks.com/services/influencer-marketing
- Social Media Marketing — channel management, content production, community management and paid social. https://inventiveclicks.com/services/social-media-marketing
- Web Design & Development — fast, SEO-first marketing websites and landing pages built with structured data. https://inventiveclicks.com/services/web-design-development
